parameters.query:
SELECT c.code AS client_code, j.id AS job_id, j.client_id, j.unique_key, j.payload_json, j.priority
FROM claim_next_job('wf08', 900, 'REPORT') j
LEFT JOIN clients c ON c.id = j.client_id

SELECT c.code AS client_code, c.display_name
FROM clients c
WHERE c.code = '{{ $json.clientCode }}'

SELECT generate_report('{{ $('Resolve report scope').item.json.clientCode }}', '{{ $('Resolve report scope').item.json.reportType }}', '{{ $('Resolve report scope').item.json.periodStart }}'::date, '{{ $('Resolve report scope').item.json.periodEnd }}'::date) AS report_id
SELECT schedule_engine_retest('{{ $('Resolve report scope').item.json.clientCode }}', CURRENT_DATE, 50) AS retest_jobs

SELECT count(*) AS open_exceptions,
       jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('type', exception_type, 'severity', severity,
                                    'title', title, 'detail', detail)) FILTER (WHERE exception_type IS NOT NULL) AS items
FROM exceptions
WHERE client_id = (SELECT id FROM clients WHERE code = '{{ $('Resolve report scope').item.json.clientCode }}')
  AND status = 'OPEN'
